name: facade-orthophoto
description: Generate seamless, metric facade ortho-elevations from overlapping photos.

interface.shortDescription: Stitch facade photos into a seamless, level ortho-elevation.
interface.longDescription: Generate a seamless, metric, frontal ortho-elevation of a building facade from overlapping photos using COLMAP/pycolmap, with automatic quality checks (level/plumb, brightness, coverage, sharpness, seams) and parameter adjustments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Generate a facade ortho-elevation from my photos.
